top_choice_rationale: Kiyotaki and Moore's collateral mechanism is a mature, foundational and sharply delimited account of how borrowing constraints and collateral values amplify macroeconomic shocks. The two-person attribution and narrow citation cleanly distinguish this discovery from the related financial-accelerator literature.
recusal_note: No profile-based connection to the proposed laureates is apparent. I have long-term coauthor relationships with committee member John Hassler and have coauthored with committee member Timo Boppart; these committee relationships do not alter my assessment.
